title: Fake fraud department calls are going around
message: Callers spoof our phone number and ask for a one-time code. We will never ask for a code. Hang up and call (555) 014-2000.
body:
Several members have received calls that show our phone number and say there is fraud on their card. The caller then asks for the one-time code we just texted.

That code lets the caller into your account. We will never ask for it. Hang up and call us at (555) 014-2000, or the number on the back of your card.

title: Online banking maintenance, Sunday October 18, 1 to 4 am
message: Online and mobile banking will be unavailable for scheduled maintenance. Cards and ATMs keep working.
body: Online and mobile banking will be offline on Sunday, October 18, from 1 am to 4 am for scheduled maintenance. Debit and credit cards, ATMs and phone banking keep working.

title: Check washing: use the drive-thru or mobile deposit
message: Thieves are taking checks from outdoor mailboxes and changing the payee. Mail checks inside the post office.
body: Check washing is on the rise. Thieves take checks from mailboxes, wash off the ink and rewrite them. Mail checks inside the post office, use bill pay, or deposit checks with mobile deposit.
